Meeting dates

Find dates for upcoming Council and Committee meetings.

Meetings are held on the fourth Tuesday of the month at 6pm. The public is welcome to attend. These meetings are live streamed and recorded.

Please note that Council is in recess for the month of January. The first Ordinary Council Meeting for 2026 is scheduled for 24 February 2026.

Council meetings are held in the Council Chamber at the City of Rockingham Administration Centre, Civic Boulevard, Rockingham on the following dates:
